scenarios.task: Clear drainage channels and planting beds on the Moscone Center green roof after storm debris buildup.
steps: Inspect parapet and anchor points before stepping onto planted areas
Rake debris from drain grates working upslope
Bag material and stage it at the designated hoist point
Check drain flow with water test before leaving area
Report blocked underdrains to the foreman

rubric.pass_if: Keeps 6 ft from parapet edge unless tied off
All drains flow freely at finish
No loose debris left on roof

scenarios.robot_role: Spot carries bagged debris from planting beds to the hoist point, reducing apprentice trips near the parapet edge.

scenarios.task: Install EMT conduit runs overhead in an occupied exhibit hall during a short changeover window.
hazards: live circuits in adjacent overhead raceways
steps: Verify LOTO on the target panel and test circuits dead
Inspect scissor lift and set it level with guardrails up
Hang conduit with appropriate straps per spacing spec
Pull bond wire and torque fittings to spec
Megger the run and tag for inspection
Clear tools before hall reopens

rubric.pass_if: LOTO applied and verified before any contact
Strap spacing and bends meet code
Guardrails up, no standing on rails, load within rating

scenarios.task: Extend wet-pipe sprinkler coverage for a new tenant booth layout in a meeting-room pod.
steps: Pull current hydraulic calcs for the zone
Verify main is isolated and drained at the control valve
Drill and hang branch line from existing grid
Install heads per spacing plan for new occupancy
Open inspection test valve and confirm flow alarm
Document head count change for the contractor's file

rubric.pass_if: Control valve closed, locked, and drained before cutting
Head spacing meets occupancy hazard class
Flow test passes and alarm triggers

scenarios.task: Patch a punctured waterproofing membrane beneath the Yerba Buena Gardens green-roof assembly.
steps: Locate the leak path and mark repair area
Hand-excavate soil and set it aside on tarps
Cut out damaged membrane square and dry the substrate
Install self-adhered patch with required overlap
Flood-test the patch before backfilling soil
Restore planting media and irrigation lines

rubric.pass_if: Repair located on actual leak path, not symptom
Full perimeter seal with correct overlap, flood-tested
Soil depth and irrigation restored to original condition

scenarios.robot_role: Go2 ferries tools and patch material across planted areas, minimizing soil compaction and apprentice carry loads.

scenarios.task: Change filters and belts on a rooftop air handler serving the ballroom during an unoccupied morning window.
hazards: electrical panel in the AHU room
steps: Confirm unit shutdown and fan LOTO at the disconnect
Open access doors and inspect fan belts and bearings
Replace filters with correct MERV rating and airflow direction
Replace worn belts and check sheave alignment
Restore panels, remove lock, and run unit through a test cycle
Log static pressure readings before and after

rubric.pass_if: Disconnect locked and tried-out before doors open
Filters seated with airflow arrows correct, no bypass
Test run shows normal static pressure and no belt squeal

scenarios.robot_role: UR10e lifts heavy filter cassettes from the service cart into the rack, keeping the apprentice out of the pinch zone.

scenarios.task: Rig and land structural steel for a temporary stage grid above the exhibit floor.
hazards: crane swing path over floor crews
steps: Attend pre-lift huddle and confirm load weight and pick point
Inspect slings and shackles; tag out suspect hardware
Attach tag lines before signaling the lift
Direct load with tag lines, keep crews outside fall radius
Land and bolt the connection before releasing slings
Signal all-clear and stow rigging

rubric.pass_if: All hardware inspected, defective pieces rejected
Tag lines attached and load never passes over personnel
Standard hand signals used, all-clear confirmed before release

scenarios.task: Prune trees and inspect irrigation on the public gardens walkways above the convention center.
steps: Set pedestrian detour signage before cutting
Inspect canopy for utility and bird-nest conflicts
Make three-point limb cuts with a ground spotter
Chip debris and stage mulch away from drains
Inspect irrigation heads for overspray onto walkways
Remove signage and reopen path

rubric.pass_if: Detour in place before first cut, removed only after cleanup
Undercut then undercut-through prevents bark tear
Walkways clear of debris and mulch, drains unobstructed
